## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.56%) and XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%) show upside while VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.29% | 1M: -16.90%) and HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG 1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.33%; LQD 1W: -0.34% | 1M: +2.05%) keep risk metrics flat.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit conditions neutral: HYG/LQD in CORRECTION (HYG 1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.33%; LQD 1W: -0.34% | 1M: +2.05%) — modest improvement over a month but flat in the week. Fear mixed: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.29% | 1M: -16.90%) signals short-term volatility pick-up against a falling month, while stocks remain bid (QQQ ABOVE TREND 1W: +2.50% | 1M: +10.84%).

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall: UUP RECOVERY (1W: +0.55% | 1M: -0.76%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +1.27%) point to stable FX/yield dynamics with no clear easing or tightening. Broad risk-on drivers exist but are offset by mixed short-term rate/duration moves.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leadership: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%) and SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +26.52%); Financials showing support XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.96% | 1M: +10.14%). Utilities weak: XLU CORRECTION (1W: -3.58% | 1M: +1.54%); style: Growth/momentum leading given XLK/XLF confirmation in breadth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leads: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.56%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +10.84%). EM/China resilient: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.02% | 1M: +11.88%) and FXI ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.60% | 1M: +5.55%), while Europe VGK is in CORRECTION (1W: -1.66% | 1M: +9.75%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative flows present: ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.41% | 1M: +11.90%) and IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.15% | 1M: +13.33%) show appetite for high-beta exposure. IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.90% | 1M: +6.89%) supports risk-taking but VXX RECOVERY warns of episodic volatility.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base/industrial metals strong on the month but pulling back this week: CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +13.01%) — underlying cyclical demand intact. Precious metals in short-term profit-taking: GLD CORRECTION (1W: -3.49% | 1M: +3.92%) and SLV CORRECTION (1W: -4.93% | 1M: +11.33%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -5.18%) while oil/gas futures ETFs show short-term rebounds — BNO RECOVERY (1W: +5.39% | 1M: -5.39%) and UNG RECOVERY (1W: +3.69% | 1M: -11.62%). Net: sector weakness on the month with episodic commodity-driven recoveries.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%) and broad US equities (SPY ABOVE TREND 1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.56%) both positive across timeframes. MAJOR DIVERGENCE: multiple ETFs (CPER, SLV, VGK, DBB among others) show 1W negative vs 1M positive — suppresses strong directional conviction.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to areas showing strength: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%), SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +26.52%), and broad SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +8.56%). Reduce exposure to laggards and defensive pockets like XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -5.18%) and monitor volatility signals (VXX RECOVERY 1W: +2.29% | 1M: -16.90%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%) and Semiconductors SOXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +26.52%) for continued leadership. BEARISH: Utilities XLU CORRECTION (1W: -3.58% | 1M: +1.54%) and Healthcare XLV (sector 1W: -2.31% | 1M: +1.31%) as potential underperformers.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial complex CPER CORRECTION (1W: -1.88% | 1M: +13.01%) for signs of re-acceleration. BEARISH: Gold GLD CORRECTION (1W: -3.49% | 1M: +3.92%) and Silver SLV CORRECTION (1W: -4.93% | 1M: +11.33%) — watch further profit-taking.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX RECOVERY (1W: +2.29% | 1M: -16.90%) as a volatility watchpoint; HYG (1W: -0.16% | 1M: +2.33%) / LQD (1W: -0.34% | 1M: +2.05%) to gauge credit direction; XLK/XLF spread (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%; XLF ABOVE TREND 1W: +0.96% | 1M: +10.14%) to monitor style leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Tech and semiconductors showing relative strength (XLK ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.56% | 1M: +14.48%; SOXX ABOVE TREND 1W: +4.85% | 1M: +26.52%), while a MAJOR divergence across commodities and regional ETFs (CPER, SLV, VGK) is the key risk to monitor.
